## Overview

`fungaR` is an R package for accessing, analyzing, and curating fungal taxonomic and distributional data from the [Flora e Funga do Brasil (FFB)](https://floradobrasil.jbrj.gov.br/consulta/) platform, maintained by the [Rio de Janeiro Botanical Garden](https://www.gov.br/jbrj/pt-br). It offers a comprehensive interface to the FFB [IPT data portal](https://ipt.jbrj.gov.br/jbrj/resource?r=lista_especies_flora_brasil): downloading, parsing, filtering, and exploring versioned Darwin Core Archive (DwC-A) checklist data — from browsing by taxonomic, geographic, or trait criteria (including fungi-specific traits such as nutritional mode and substrate/host) to resolving your own species name lists against it.

Beyond data retrieval, `fungaR` also assists taxonomic experts contributing to FFB by cross-checking [MycoBank](https://www.mycobank.org), [Species Fungorum](https://www.speciesfungorum.org) (Index Fungorum), and Brazilian occurrence repositories — [GBIF](https://www.gbif.org), [speciesLink](https://specieslink.net), and the [Reflora Virtual Herbarium](https://ipt.jbrj.gov.br/reflora/) — to flag fungal species and state records that are plausibly Brazilian but still missing from the platform.

## Flora e Funga do Brasil

Brazil harbors one of the richest fungal diversities in the world. The checklist that documents it began in 2008 as the *Lista de Espécies da Flora do Brasil*, evolved into [Flora do Brasil 2020](http://doi.org/10.47871/jbrj2021004) to meet Brazil's Global Strategy for Plant Conservation commitments, and — after incorporating fungi — became [Flora e Funga do Brasil](https://floradobrasil.jbrj.gov.br/consulta/).

For each accepted fungal name, FFB records nomenclatural status, taxonomic classification (Division, Order, Family, Genus), geographic distribution, endemism, nutritional/ecological mode, and substrate/host information — a validated taxonomic backbone assembled collaboratively by hundreds of taxonomists and mycologists, and published as versioned Darwin Core Archives.

## Package Description

Package: `fungaR`
Type: R Package
Version: 1.0.0

Author: Domingos Cardoso ([\@DBOSlab](https://github.com/DBOSlab) [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0000-0001-7072-2656))

Maintainer: Domingos Cardoso (<domingoscardoso@jbrj.gov.br>)

### Features

- Comprehensive interface to the Flora e Funga do Brasil IPT data portal
- Version tracking and offline-capable parsing of downloaded DwC-A datasets
- Checklist filtering by taxonomic, geographic, and trait-based (including substrate/host) criteria
- Exact and fuzzy (Levenshtein-distance) name resolution against the checklist
- Taxonomic hierarchy traversal at any rank, from division down to species, on FFB's real fungi hierarchy
- Cross-checking MycoBank, Index Fungorum, GBIF, speciesLink, and REFLORA to flag species and state records missing from FFB, or retrieving MycoBank/Index Fungorum records for a Brazilian taxon directly
- Tidyverse-integrated workflows throughout

## Contribute

You can contribute to `fungaR` by:

- Opening issues for feedback or bug reports
- Submitting pull requests for fixes or enhancements
- Suggesting or developing new features (please open an issue for discussion first)
